eval.description: UK AI Security Institute held-out cyber range: a 32-step simulated corporate-network attack spanning reconnaissance through credential theft, lateral movement, CI/CD pivots, and data exfiltration. Agents act without active blockers. Cards report average steps completed (of 32) and end-to-end solve counts under fixed token budgets.
